Visit note | 2025-08-18 09:30 AM | Dr. Shamima Nasrin, Ophthalmology | Patient: Ehsan Mollah, 42, male. Mr. Mollah attends for review, reporting that his eye symptoms feel worse in air conditioning and during long hours of screen time. He mentions his eyes have felt particularly irritated since taking on night shifts at a call centre in Kushtia. He works as a beautician. He has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. He denies pain, redness, or blurring of vision. On examination: tear break-up time 4 seconds, BP 126/78 mmHg, pulse 83 bpm, weight 86 kg. Corneas are clear and conjunctivae are moist. Assessment: Dry eye syndrome. Plan: chronic follow-up: continue current medicines, no new prescription issued. He was advised to look away from the screen every 20 minutes, blink often, and use a humidifier. Follow-up in 1 month.
